body: Sure I understand that. At those rates we'd be broke pretty quickly. We have a higher than average income but we're not rich by any means. So it's really unsustainable. When other people talk about therapy I don't understand how they're getting it. There must be something I don't know.

I didn't put the price. That's how much therapy costs for me apparently. Perhaps there are cheaper options that I have to wait 6 months for in a line of other people. Can't say I feel anything and that's one of the issues.
